featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wanted to visit some good places where I can try a variety of juice and shakes so I visited the craufet market, so I tried searching for some famous stalls or places for food/juice for which I got to know that "Pappu Juice wala" is pretty famous on Mohammad Ali Road. I saw the pictures and decided to visit.

So the stall is at the main road itself, you will easily locate it via Google map. So they provide juice and shakes according to season, currently strawberry is the main fruit. The cost of juice/shakes is very economical you can try it in the range of Rs50-Rs200 all the juices.

They use fresh fruits and everything, they cut the fruits right in front of you. The only thing I did not like was the hygiene. So just next to the stall they have a dustbin where you can throw you cutleries and everything and they throw the residue of the fruits. So, this dustbin attracts lots of flies and other insects. At the same time due to too many crowds they keep cutting the fruit continuously for the juice and shakes but they do not cover it with anything, so the fruit pieces are open and the shop is on the road and they have a dustbin as well next to the stall. So I will definitely recommend them to change this.

Talking about the shakes you shall definitely try the strawberry 🍓 cream shake, they use fresh strawberry and cream it is recommended.
Whereas you can also try coconut cream shake, they serve it in the coconut shell. I am not much of a fan of 🥥 coconut thus I did not like it, but my friends love it. so you shall definitely try that too. It's an all season thing.

Rest I am sharing the photos which you can see and judge accordingly.

featured_reviews.name: Himanshu Gajbhiye
featured_reviews.review_text:
A very popular fruit juice corner. Their most unique serving is the cream of fruit juices like watermelon cream, coconut cream, mango cream etc.
In that, they first prepare a normal juice of that fruit. Take it out in a fancy hollow coconut/container. Pour the juice in it.
And then they spread amul fresh cream all over it , further garnishing it with dry fruits.
The dish thus prepared is so unique that one might not have tasted it for sure ever. It also is so damn tasty that it will surely make you give another visit.

featured_reviews.name: Adv Surabhi Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a really disappointing experience here and honestly didn’t expect this level of service.

I ordered a strawberry matcha with almond milk and made sure to clearly repeat my order twice to the staff taking it. Despite that, what I received was nowhere close to what I asked for, it was literally like a strawberry milkshake. That’s not a small mistake; it completely changes the drink.

When it came to the matcha itself, it was even worse. The taste was completely off and felt very poorly put together. Instead of using something like real strawberry jam or compote, they seemed to have just added some artificial strawberry essence. It tasted synthetic and unpleasant, which completely ruined the matcha experience.

This isn’t just about taste. it’s about basic attention to orders and quality control. When you’re charging premium prices for specialty beverages, the least you can do is get the order right and maintain some standard in preparation.

Really disappointing overall. Definitely not the kind of experience you expect when ordering something as simple as a matcha.

featured_reviews.name: Burjiz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mumbai Central Snacks and Juice Centre is one of those convenient little spots right near Mumbai Central railway station and close to the bridge at Nathani Heights.

There are two shops. The one I usually go to is the one at the right of the building and near the entry point of the internal building parking.

It's mainly a takeaway kind of place, especially since there’s no real seating unless you’re okay just standing outside and eating. But for what it is, it works well.

I’ve tried their veg club grill here multiple times and that’s something I’d recommend as it's good and quote filling.

The fruit juices are fresh as well, and overall the menu covers a decent range of quick bites like burgers, pizza, pav bhaji, etc. It’s all pure vegetarian, which is worth keeping in mind.

Another plus is that it stays open quite late, which makes it a reliable option if you’re around the area at night and looking for something quick.

Pricing is reasonable, portions are fair, and service is generally quick and efficient which is basically what you’d expect from a place like this.

Not somewhere you’d go to sit and relax, but for a quick bite or takeaway near Mumbai Central, it does the job well.

featured_reviews.name: varun jethani
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐☆☆☆☆

Went to Haji Ali Juice Centre around 5 AM with a lot of excitement, expecting a good experience, but it turned out very disappointing. The cashier was extremely arrogant, the steward had almost zero communication skills, and another staff member was very confusing to deal with. Even before tasting the food, the service already ruined the mood.

Still, I thought maybe the taste would make up for it — but honestly, it was just bad. The sandwich and pizza bread were terrible and felt very overrated. The mango cream was only okay, but even the raw mango in it didn’t feel fresh or up to the mark. They served the pizza instantly but made us wait almost 20 minutes for a veg sandwich, which clearly felt reheated and not fresh. Overall, not recommended if you’re looking for quality food or good service. The shops in front seemed like a much better option.

featured_reviews.name: Sinan Shaan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Haji Ali Juice Centre after visiting Haji Ali Dargah as we wanted to have some fresh juice. Even though I was having cold and cough, I still wanted to try something here. We noticed many varieties of cream puddings displayed, which looked very tempting. Since it was our first time, we asked the staff which one was the best, and they suggested the Seetha Phal (custard apple) cream pudding, so we ordered that along with rose milk falooda.
As they said, the Seetha Phal cream pudding was extraordinary and super in taste, very rich and satisfying. The rose milk falooda was good, but not as special as the pudding. They also serve many other juices, desserts, and snacks.
Prices are definitely on the higher side, and most items feel expensive. The ambience is simple and nothing fancy, and the service is just okay. Overall, the Seetha Phal cream pudding is highly recommended if you visit here.

featured_reviews.name: Sakib Mulla
featured_reviews.review_text:
A perennial favorite among locals and tourists alike, Haji Ali Juice Centre is an iconic culinary landmark nestled at the threshold of the historic Haji Ali Dargah. Since its inception in the 1960s, this bustling establishment has cultivated a legendary status, evolving from a modest stop for pilgrims into a vibrant gastronomic institution. It is celebrated for its unwavering commitment to quality, utilizing fresh, seasonal ingredients to craft an extensive repertoire of refreshments that have become synonymous with Mumbai's street food culture.
Reviewers frequently highlight the establishment's ability to maintain high standards of hygiene and flavor despite the immense daily crowds. The atmosphere is quintessentially Mumbai—a high-energy, casual setting where patrons often enjoy their treats standing on the pavement or from the comfort of their cars, adding a unique drive-in charm to the experience.
• Signature Fruit Creams: The "Sitaphal" (custard apple) cream is universally acclaimed as a must-try masterpiece, featuring a luscious, thick consistency generously laden with fresh fruit chunks.
• Exotic Shakes & Juices: Guests often praise the Mango Milkshake for its rich, creamy texture and the "Triveni"—a sophisticated blend of mango, strawberry, and kiwi juices.
• Savoury Accompaniments: Beyond beverages, the menu boasts popular fusion snacks like the Jain Pizza and the indulgent Cheese Toast, noted for its generous cheese-to-bread ratio.
• Late-Night Accessibility: Operating from the early morning until well past midnight, it serves as a reliable sanctuary for night revelers seeking high-quality refreshments.

featured_reviews.name: Patricia
featured_reviews.review_text: The Haji Ali Juice centre is such an iconic eatery in Mumbai. It's a must visit if you are visiting Mumbai for the first time for sure. They have some of the most delicious shakes and ice creams. But my favourite is the strawberry cream. It's absolutely delicious. Having ice cream late at night near the sea is such a fun experience.

featured_reviews.name: Sanoop ks
featured_reviews.review_text:
Haji Ali Juice Centre is one of those places in Mumbai that almost everyone has heard about, and naturally, expectations are quite high before visiting. The menu is extensive, filled with a wide variety of juices, shakes, and desserts that look appealing at first glance. The taste of the items is definitely good—fresh, flavorful, and satisfying to an extent. You can tell that the ingredients are of decent quality and prepared well.

However, beyond that initial impression, nothing truly stands out. There isn’t anything particularly unique or memorable about the flavors that would make you want to come back again and again. It feels like what you get is something you could easily find at many other juice shops across the city.

One of the biggest drawbacks is how overhyped the place feels. Because of its popularity and constant crowd, you go in expecting something exceptional, but the experience turns out to be fairly average. This mismatch between expectation and reality is quite noticeable.

On top of that, the pricing feels a bit on the higher side for what is offered. While the quality is decent, it doesn’t quite justify the cost, making it seem overrated.

Overall, Haji Ali Juice Centre delivers good taste but nothing extraordinary. It’s worth trying once for the experience, but it may not live up to the hype surrounding it.

featured_reviews.review_text: After paying our respects at Haji Ali Dargah, we were all tired in the midday heat. If you want to try fresh and pure smoothies and sandwiches than drunken monkey is the right place to visit.

This place has Limited seating but they have a wide range of drinks and food in their menu card. More than 200+ smoothies are available.

Few special secrets  drinks are available whose ingredients are not revealed since it is the Usp of this outlet.

I tried out some mind blowing smoothies and I guarantee if u have 1 it will full your stomach with joy and love .
Grapes and apple juice, these were 100% purely made from fruits and vegetables. No added sugar

Tried Chicken sausages which was thick and again the best thing to go with juices.

They have veg quesadillas I tried out there panner one . Vegetarian must give a try.

Food-5/5
Ambience-4.5/5
Taste-5/5

featured_reviews.name: Jui ly
featured_reviews.review_text:
Drunken Monkey is located at Arneja Corner, Sec 17( Vashi). It is approximately 10to 15 minutes away from Vashi Railway Station. They have more than 200 varieties of smoothies.You can also customize them as per your preference.They also offer Detox pack, perfect to flush out junk

It is small and cosy place which can accommodate 10to 15 people.Classy blue and grey combination interior. Some unique quotes on the wall. They also have board games. A perfect way to enjoy with your friends. The coolest thing in this outlet is the Guitar.

Staff here is helpful and humble.Service is a bit slow considering everything is prepared fresh. Special thanks to Sirin and Shiva for making our visit more enjoyable.

☸ Watermelon Classic

In this they have three variant

Classic Epic Magic

I tried Watermelon Classic.It was very soothing. Note that they don't add extra sugar. Healthy and Refreshing.

☸ Chocolate Nutella

Chocolate Nutella shake. I would absolutely love shake anytime of the day.It was served chilled in their signature glass bottle.It was rich, thick and chocolaty.Flavours were spot on. Highly Recommended.

☸ Tofu Tikka Sandwich

Brown bread tofu sandwich.It was average in taste. This could have been better.Food menu is limited so would love to see more options in it.

☸ Monkey Special

Combination of oats, apple and milk.Healthy yet so tasty. It was fantastic in taste.Highly Recommended.

Drunken Monkey serves some amazing smoothies. Smoothies with no artificial flavour, no added sugar, preservatives and concentrates.They also have one amazing offer Buy a smoothie n get food for 99/-

This place is a must visit for sure.

featured_reviews.name: Swapnil Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text: If you want to try some excellent beverages then Drunken Monkey can be the right place for you. Situated in Vashi sector 17, Drunken Monkey serves varieties of beverages and it has excellent taste. During my visit to Drunken Monkey's Vashi outlet I've tried their Iron Bronx Avocado smoothie, it has taste but wasn't as described in the menu, was expecting more. Then I've tried Kiwi Epic Smoothie, was good in taste. I've tried their Sandwich and Quesadilla both were excellent in taste. Overall it's a fun place for spending time with small group, as the outlet is comparably small. They do have boardgames to pass the time.

featured_reviews.name: Pratik
featured_reviews.review_text:
Looking for an all variety beverage outlet in vashi then stop your search and march yourself to this healthy, tasty, deliciously drooling beverage outlet "Drunken Monkey".

Well first of all not many of us are a big fan of beverages and juices but trust me the variety they serve has a wide range of healthy as well as tasty options as well alongside some munchies variety as well to enjoy with.

The variety includes wide range of,

Cold coffees,
Protein smoothies,
Avocado smoothies,
Hot drinks,
Veggies smoothies,
Fresh fruit shakes and many more to select from.

Outlet is located at a walking distance from vashi railway station and i must say the place is awesome as well. The interiors and the posters inside specifying the tagline are very quirky.

The staff was very much courteous and helped us getting explained the variety in their menu. And the service was very much timely as well.

We had some sandwiches alongside the beverages which included,

1. Chicken Tandoor Sandwich
2. Cheese Jalepeno Chicken Sandwich

And in beverages we had one hot and other two cold ones,

1. Choco Almond
2. Arabian Knights
3. Super Food

Arabian Knights was from the protein shake variety which contained 30gms of protein alongside the dates and figs with cashew and almonds. So taste worthy.

Choco almond was a hot beverage which was Chocolate based with almonds. Well not much to explain as it was a conventional chocolate based one.

Then came the Super Food, which was from their Detox variety and I was so much satisfied with the taste and the aftereffects of it if you can read it in their menu.

Well thumbs up to all the staffs for serving us on time and so much drooling food and beverages.

A must visit outlet in vashi if you are looking for a variety of options in beverages.

featured_reviews.name: Chanchal Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
The place is small but very well utilised and the interiors are done well. The service is fast. They have a huge range in shakes from health freak to junkies. They have shakes starting from protein shake, meal replacement shakes, detox, hangover drinks like possibly every drink u could think off.
In shakes ordered for choco nutella and monkey confidential part 2.
In food they have sandwiches and quasadilla . Ordered for Mexican Grill tofu quasadilla and tofu tikka sandwich.
The shakes are really good in taste and are healthy as well. For the chocolate lovers there are chocolate shakes as well.

featured_reviews.name: Sumit Nair
featured_reviews.review_text: Walked in randomly on an evening walk, the ambience is pleasing to the eye, thankfully we walked in at a time when it was less crowded. Tried a few signature detoxes. Good Music we could have a conversation as this wasn't extremely loud. Unfortunately they had run out of Sandwiches, so we tried the quesadilla and we absolutely loved it!!!!

The place has a very classic ambinence with monkey imprints all around which justifies their name 💕
You can have juices and shakes from their wide range of menu and make your own one too
It's AFFORDABLE and WORTH THE PENNY.

name: Juice Time
description:
Juice Time – Pure Vegetarian & Jain Restaurant | Opera House, Mumbai

For 14 years, Juice Time has proudly served 100% pure vegetarian and Jain food, prepared with love, purity, and flavor. Known for its wide range of freshly made juices, rolls, sandwiches, pasta, pizzas, Chinese, Asian, Oriental, Italian, Mexican, sizzlers, pav bhaji, and desserts, Juice Time is your go-to spot for delicious vegetarian meals.

Whether you’re craving a wholesome snack or a full meal, enjoy a fresh, hygienic, and flavor-packed dining experience — because at Juice Time, we’re proudly vegetarian and always will be.

This is one of the sobos best veg and jain restaurant. My jain friends visit this restaurant too often and they love the food out here. Even i came here for the 3rd time in a row. As soon as I came to know they introduced some new items on the menu, I went there to try it .
Some of their regulars are  bamboo rice and various varieties of rolls .
Apart from these we tried their cheesy pao bhaji, cheese burst pizza which melted our hearts , hummus platter , and spicy panner burger . We loved everything.
Drinks were also on point eena meena deeka which was a combination drink .
It was really good to see that they keep on introducing new items on the menu . Will keep visiting for such more often .

featured_reviews.name: DISHA HARAN
featured_reviews.review_text: “Juice Time is truly a hidden gem in South Mumbai for pure veg & Jain food lovers! 🌟 Open till late night, the menu has so much variety with fresh flavors, quick service, and great quality. Perfect spot for family dinners, midnight cravings, and even small celebrations with their spacious party area. Highly recommended for anyone looking for tasty vegetarian food with a great vibe! 💚”

featured_reviews.name: suraj pagare (Sam on demand)
featured_reviews.review_text: For vegetarians this place is just amazing, Absolutely loved this restaurant! The food is delicious with an amazing variety of dishes to choose from. Every item we tried was full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The dessert section is equally impressive with so many tempting options. The ambiance is great, and the service was warm and attentive. A perfect spot for food lovers – highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Ridham Porwal
featured_reviews.review_text: Food that speaks for itself, drinks that impress, and an ambience you’ll want to stay in all night. Every dish was a perfect balance of flavor and presentation. Definitely a place worth coming back to.”

featured_reviews.name: Dhananjay Purohit
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an absolutely terrible experience at Juice Time. The customer service was beyond disappointing — the staff were rude, inattentive, and acted like they were doing me a favor by even acknowledging my order. There was zero professionalism and no basic courtesy.

The food was just as bad. What I received was poorly prepared, tasted awful, and honestly felt unhygienic. It’s shocking how low the quality was, especially considering how simple the menu is.

What made it worse was the overall attitude — no accountability, no apology, and no effort to improve the situation. It’s one thing to serve bad food, but combining that with such disgusting service makes it a place I would strongly advise everyone to avoid.

Definitely one of the worst experiences I’ve had. Never ordering from here again.

featured_reviews.name: Pavan J
featured_reviews.review_text:
Juice Time - a genuinely disappointing experience.
The staff came across as rude and completely lacking basic hospitality. What made it worse was the poor handling by the manager, who added no value in resolving the situation.
Their furniture ended up spoiling my shirt, yet there was no proper apology, accountability, or compensation offered.
A place can only improve when the good for nothing manager is fired or changed

featured_reviews.name: Aadil Rakhangi
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited this place late evening. Ambience is very very good. Nice place to chill with friends. Had ordered Pita Bread with Hammus. Followed by Pasta. Taste was very good. For cold drink tried the Mulberry Juice. It was again very nice. Overall experience was very nice. Helpful staff. Good service. Definitely would recommend one to visit this place.

featured_reviews.name: The Wandering Veggie
featured_reviews.review_text:
We ordered Falafel Shawarma 🥙, Pasta pe Pasta and Firangi (Peru+Strawberry) Juice 🍹

The Falafel Shawarma  was lovely, hummus, pickled beetroot, other veggies, falafels, everything was perfect.

The Firangi juice had more peru(guava) taste than strawberry, but was fresh and not too sugary. Will definitely try other curious combos the next time.

Pasta pe Pasta was a combination of macaroni in cheesy sauce and speghetti in red sauce, taste was pretty good, the breads served with it were a little dry.

Staff was very nice and let us use the group seating area which could easily accommodate 9-10 people although we were just 2. The ambience is pretty good.

If you advance book through Zomato Gold Dining option and then pay through Zomato Gold, you get flat 15% off on total bill which is a steal deal.

featured_reviews.name: Bhavika Kaklotar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I strongly request everyone not to visit this place.

We ordered a fruit bowl costing around ₹300 for our 10-month-old baby, assuming that under a brand name, the quality would be good and premium. Unfortunately, this assumption turned out to be completely false.

I clearly requested their staff not to add any tangy fruits, yet they still added orange, which was extremely sour—so much so that even adults could not eat it.

The rest of the fruits, including apple and papaya, were in very poor condition and not fresh at all.

Overall, the fruit quality was extremely low—worse than what is usually offered by street vendors. This was a very disappointing and unacceptable experience, especially when it involved food for an infant.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Amarfal and jamun juice were okay.
THE SERVERS DID NOT WEAR GLOVES and handled everything including their phones during making juice. Expensive

featured_reviews.name: Andy B
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located at top level of Oberio Mall sandwiched between Burger King & Taco Bell, it is a small outlets but commands it's own patron.

The selling point is health. But don't be surprised if you don't get your desired drink. This is what happened to us. We wanted avocado juice, but to our dismay there weren't any. Neither were there any notification that specific drinks are not available.

We settled for grapes and berry juice. For the taste, we think there were added sugar to enhance the taste. But good enough. They ask you beforehand if you want ice added or not. Stick to seasonal fruits & vegetables.

Experience: A very disinterested person took our order with short responses. It took about 3 to 5 min on a weekday for my order. Straws provided are sealed (+ point). They accept cash, paytm and cards.
